selection_rule: A candidate must close the isotope-to-element conversion, decay horizon, ejecta mass, remnant ownership, event energy, momentum convention, licensing, source checksum, and deterministic conversion checksum before approval.

candidates.citation: Keegans et al. 2023, Type Ia Supernova Nucleosynthesis: Metallicity-Dependent Yields
candidates.coverage: 39 models from three progenitor/explosion families over 13 22Ne composition points
candidates.yield_basis: complete isotopic abundance yields with a decayed-isotope supplementary package
candidates.license: CC-BY-4.0 for the Zenodo data record
blockers: source files are staged for review, but source-specific normalization and conversion are not approved
isotope-to-project-element aggregation and decay horizon are not yet pinned
the staged decayed package omits H, He, C, and N required by the project 11-element ledger
per-event returned mass and remnant ownership require an explicit contract
event energy and momentum are not supplied as a closed runtime source record
progenitor/explosion mixture and metallicity weighting are not selected

candidates.citation: Seitenzahl et al. 2013, Three-dimensional delayed-detonation models with nucleosynthesis for Type Ia supernovae
candidates.coverage: 14 three-dimensional delayed-detonation models with detailed tracer-particle nucleosynthesis
candidates.yield_basis: isotopic ejecta yields; model family spans ignition conditions and central-density variants
candidates.license: not established for redistribution in this project
blockers: redistribution/license terms and machine-readable source package are not staged
the model family is not a selected LRD progenitor mixture
decay convention, element aggregation, event energy, and momentum remain to be closed
source checksum and deterministic conversion checksum are absent

candidates.citation: Kromer et al. 2017, Simulating the observed diversity of Type Ia supernovae — Introducing a model data base
candidates.coverage: archive-level candidate; individual Type Ia model IDs must be selected and staged
candidates.yield_basis: integrated isotopic abundances plus model-dependent ejecta profiles where available
candidates.license: model-dependent archive terms; redistribution status not established for this project
blockers: an archive is not a unique physical source; a concrete model ID and version must be selected
machine-readable abundance/profile files, exact checksums, and redistribution terms are not staged
decay convention and isotope-to-project-element aggregation must be pinned
ejecta mass, event energy, and signed momentum must be derived or supplied with a documented profile convention
the selected model must be checked for the project 11-element ledger without inferred zeros
population weighting over Chandrasekhar/sub-Chandrasekhar model families remains unapproved

decision.current_recommendation: Use Keegans et al. 2023 as the leading composition candidate, HESMA as the leading profile/energetics-closure candidate, and Seitenzahl et al. 2013 as an independent comparison. Do not select any source or write physical event values into the production contract yet.
